controls.label: prettier
controls.note: Mechanical and reviewable in one commit. Add the reformat commit to .git-blame-ignore-revs so history stays readable.

controls.label: eslint
controls.note: Flat config, recommended set only. Type-aware rules are a later task: they need a working tsconfig and cost real time per run.

controls.label: tsc --noEmit
controls.note: The single highest-value control in this stack. On legacy JS, adopt via tsconfig.strict.json over a narrowing include list rather than flipping strict on the root config.

controls.label: vitest
controls.note: The behaviour harness. Without it the type checker only proves shapes, not conduct.

controls.label: coverage floor
controls.note: Set thresholds to the CURRENT measured value and ratchet upward as a tracked task.

controls.label: lefthook
controls.note: Install after the underlying tools are clean, never before.
